kind: Orchestrator cross-contract inspection; not independent Phase G acceptance
subject: Uncommitted Phase F kernel/authority and company/human drafts in their isolated author worktrees

findings.issue: Command acceptance and common types diverge between drafts: independently witnessed acceptance, UTC timestamps, Money exponent, Position/watermarks and identity/intent aliases need one canonical definition.
findings.status: Reported to authors; final revision not yet verified

findings.issue: Capability dependency lists contain startup cycles; a fresh venture needs a valid first investigation/design path without invented prior customers, support or fulfillment evidence.
findings.status: Reported; distinguish capability availability from conditional required records and prior completed runs

findings.issue: LaunchReadiness delivery/support fields still use model ExecutionCapacity where actual DeliveryCapacity is required.
findings.status: Reported to author; final revision not yet verified

findings.issue: Required integer financial observations need a typed unknown/absent representation; prose alone cannot prevent unobserved costs becoming zero or prevent preparatory work from deadlocking.
findings.status: Reported; spend authority must still require exact bounded quantities

findings.issue: Native CLI internal request counts can be opaque. Enforce finite observable job/wall/process/output/network bounds without inventing provider quota or making all native paths ineligible.
findings.status: Author agrees to revise; final contract and later admission tests unverified

findings.issue: Concrete protected deployment needs a priced bill of materials, maintenance labor and a simpler comparator under the same fault contract. Dedicated gateway host was not required by the stated trusted-host boundary.
findings.status: Author proposes co-located R/G privilege boundaries and explicit alternatives; cost adequacy remains unestablished

findings.issue: Nine component interface rows do not alone supply every required responsibility, nonresponsibility, owner, state, lifecycle, trust, observability, evaluation, scaling, version and removal contract.
findings.status: Explicit remaining full-plan obligation; author notified
